title: One Perfect Day in Sioux Falls
subtitle: From morning coffee to a downtown fine dining dinner, a full day hitting the city's real highlights.

stops.note: Start with small-batch roasted coffee before the day gets moving.
Sioux Falls' namesake waterfalls — climb the rocks, ride the observation tower elevator.
Walk downtown Phillips Avenue through the world's largest annual outdoor sculpture exhibit.
Lunch at a genuinely authentic, farm-fresh Indian kitchen.
Free admission to three floors of regional history inside a restored 1889 quartzite courthouse.
A mid-afternoon break at a working roastery-and-taproom.
Close the day with a chef-driven tasting menu in the historic Harvester Building.

seo.title: One Perfect Day in Sioux Falls: A Local's Itinerary
seo.description: A full day in Sioux Falls hitting Falls Park, SculptureWalk, real local coffee, and a fine dining finish — all real, verified stops.
